settings.title: Sarah Jenkins — Staff Systems Engineer
settings.seoDescription: Staff software engineer building distributed systems, Kubernetes tools, and high-performance microservices.

profile.name: Sarah Jenkins
profile.headline: Building resilient distributed systems, developer tooling, and modern web platforms.
profile.bio: Over 8 years designing fault-tolerant backend microservices and delightful front-end web applications with TypeScript, Go, and Rust. Passionate about developer productivity and open-source software.

about.title: Background
about.content:
I specialize in full-stack architecture, high-throughput message streaming, and distributed databases. Previously led engineering initiatives at Stripe and Cloudflare scaling real-time payment ingestion pipelines.

When I am not debugging concurrency issues, I mentor early-career engineers and contribute to open-source systems libraries.
about.highlightText: Available for high-impact architecture consulting and staff-level roles.
about.availability: Open to select advisory & senior roles

projects.title: KubeStream - Realtime Event Router
projects.summary: A high-throughput telemetry router written in Rust with sub-millisecond p99 latency for Kubernetes cluster observability.

projects.title: TypeSync - Distributed State Engine
projects.summary: Conflict-free replicated data types (CRDT) engine powering multi-user collaborative editing in modern web browsers.

projects.title: PulseDB - Time-Series Storage Engine
projects.summary: Lightweight, memory-efficient columnar storage engine designed for edge analytics and IoT telemetry ingestion.

experience.description: Architected global edge deployment workers processing 45B+ monthly API calls with 99.999% uptime. Reduced cold-start overhead by 42% across regional worker nodes.
Engineered idempotency layers and transactional payment routing for global checkout systems. Mentored 6 mid-level engineers and drove architecture reviews.
Developed build pipeline enhancements and edge routing utilities for Next.js preview deployments.

education.description: Graduated with Honors. Undergraduate researcher in parallel computing laboratory.

contact.note: Feel free to reach out regarding distributed systems speaking engagements or technical advisory.

profile.name: Alex Chen
profile.headline: Crafting brand identities, visual languages, and tactile digital products for forward-thinking studios.
profile.bio: Specialized in brand systems, editorial visual design, and interactive design direction. Partnered with Apple, Nike, Teenage Engineering, and leading venture-backed startups.

about.title: Creative Practice
about.content:
I operate at the intersection of graphic design, motion, and digital product craftsmanship. Every project is guided by purposeful typography, thoughtful material tension, and an obsession with clarity.

Available for selected brand identity commissions, product launch creative direction, and design consulting.

settings.title: Marcus Vance — Design Systems
settings.seoDescription: Design systems lead and typography specialist crafting deliberate software interfaces.

profile.name: Marcus Vance
profile.headline: Designing thoughtful, humane software interfaces with uncompromising attention to typography and rhythm.
profile.bio: Over seven years creating scalable design systems and accessible consumer software. Believer in subtraction, deliberate typography, and high-craft interaction details.

about.title: Philosophy & Focus
about.content:
I believe the best interfaces feel inevitable. They get out of the user's way, communicate with calm confidence, and age gracefully.

My daily work involves crafting design foundations, writing comprehensive component documentation, and bridging the gap between product strategy and front-end engineering.
about.highlightText: Focused on clarity, accessibility, and durability over fleeting design trends.

projects.title: Linear Design System v2
projects.summary: A unified component library, color token architecture, and keyboard navigation model used across desktop, web, and mobile clients.

projects.title: Calm Reader - Distraction-free Reading Client
projects.summary: A cross-platform typography-first reading environment designed for extended reading without eye fatigue or algorithmic interruptions.

projects.title: Notate - Markdown Knowledge Base
projects.summary: Local-first networked thought notebook with instant full-text search, bidirectional linking, and zero cloud lock-in.

experience.description: Leading interface design for cloud infrastructure dashboards, deployments, and edge network analytics tools.
Redesigned core budgeting and financial savings features, improving 30-day user retention by 18%.

education.description: Specialization in typography, information design, and editorial systems.

contact.note: I reply to all design discussions and thoughtful project proposals within 48 hours.
